notes.A: The basin and red skyline dominate, with the flame pedestal clipped at left.
notes.B: The high angle reveals the pedestal and surrounding streets, but cuts off the basin.
notes.C: The basin leads the eye to the flame, but the pedestal’s inscription faces away.
notes.D: The flame and basin sit side by side, but the pedestal presents a blank face.
notes.E: The inscribed pedestal anchors the street corner, but partly hides the basin.
notes.F: The flame and basin share the foreground, though a streetlamp interrupts the inscription.
notes.G: The low angle shows the inscription, but a looming streetlamp competes with the flame.
notes.H: The basin sits against the fiery skyline, with most of the pedestal out of frame.

monument.best: F shows the inscribed flame pedestal and green basin together, framed by streetlamps and the surrounding city blocks.
monument.lacks: The plaza lacks a focal point at the scale of the square. The low pedestal and basin feel like separate fixtures scattered across a broad expanse of paving.
monument.fix: Build one broad stepped platform for the flame and basin so they read as a single memorial from across the square.

blind_name.name: Monument plaza
blind_name.why: Streetlamps surround a stepped stone pedestal with a flame, and tall buildings frame the paved square.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure the building entrances.

notes.A: A skeleton guards the aisle, while a stone pier reduces the altar to a glimpse.
notes.B: Pews lead toward the chapel name and banner, but the shrine recedes into shadow.
notes.C: A skeleton stands beside the pews, with a bulky pier breaking up the room.
notes.D: The red sky frames the avenue, but the chapel reads as a long side wall.
notes.E: Candles and stained glass frame the altar, while a pier hides the nave.
notes.F: The elevated view shows the entrance and tower, but repeated windows dominate the façade.
notes.G: A torch lights the pews and saint’s alcove, but the tight crop truncates both.
notes.H: Patched masonry and repeated windows flatten the chapel into a street elevation.

avenue.best: B shows the pews, chapel name, hanging banner and skeletal guard together, making the room’s purpose and menace legible.
avenue.lacks: The nave lacks a strong focal point. The pews draw the eye toward a dim wall, while the candlelit altar sits out of view.
avenue.fix: Move the candlelit altar and its stained-glass backdrop to the head of the central aisle, where the pews already direct the eye.

blind_name.name: Stone chapel
blind_name.why: Rows of wooden pews face a gold-crested banner, with colored windows set high in the stone walls.
blind_name.odd: The portrait on the left is partly cut off.

notes.A: Pews, a tapestry, and a figure beneath the GALLOWS sign suggest a story; framing feels cramped.
notes.B: A portrait and colored windows show the interior decoration, but the overhang dominates.
notes.C: The broadside shows the window rhythm and tower base, but flattens the church’s shape.
notes.D: The wooden door and alley establish street access, but the near wall dominates.
notes.E: The high angle shows the slit windows and street, but cuts off the entrance.
notes.F: The oblique view connects the windows to the entrance, but the blank upper wall dominates.
notes.G: The candlelit altar anchors the sanctuary, but thick doorway walls make it feel boxed in.
notes.H: The window row, tower, and door define the street frontage, but foreground brick crowds it.

church_out.best: The altar, stained glass, candles, statue, and banner give the church a clear identity and a sense of ritual.
church_out.lacks: The church lacks a nave with enough height and depth to give the altar a commanding presence. The sanctuary feels like a decorated alcove.
church_out.fix: Raise the nave into a tall, stepped vault that leads the eye from the pews to the altar.

blind_name.name: Chapel altar
blind_name.why: A stone altar stands beneath stained glass, flanked by lit candelabras.
blind_name.odd: The stained-glass figure is hard to make out.

notes.A: Pews, a banner, and skeletons give the rear wall character, though the altar is absent.
notes.B: The side aisle leads past a tapestry toward the altar, dwarfed by the left overhang.
notes.C: A skeleton stands between the stone pier and pews, with little depth beyond them.
notes.D: Rows of pews frame a portrait at the aisle’s end, beneath a screen-filling overhang.
notes.E: The frontal view centers the altar and candles, with the pew rows overlapping.
notes.F: The raised angle reveals the pew layout, but ceiling and masonry crowd the sanctuary.
notes.G: High windows and a tapestry frame the nave, with the nearest pew clipped.
notes.H: A skeleton guards a recess beside a portrait, with most of the seating cropped out.

nave.best: The diagonal view shows how the pews lead toward the candlelit altar, with stained glass and a skeleton in view.
nave.lacks: The nave lacks lighting that draws the eye down the aisle. Gray masonry and dark pews dominate even with the altar in view.
nave.fix: Light the sanctuary with a warm pool that catches the altar steps and spills onto the nearest pews.

blind_name.name: Chapel nave
blind_name.why: Wooden pews face a raised altar with candles and stained glass.
blind_name.odd: The wall hanging’s design is hard to make out.

notes.A: The carved lid and barrel row read clearly, but the tomb crowds the frame.
notes.B: Two burial panels flank a torch, while a close web obscures the left side.
notes.C: The sarcophagus and barrels fill the view, with the skeleton clipped at the edge.
notes.D: The long sarcophagus anchors both figures, though its bulk hides much of the floor.
notes.E: The sarcophagus, burial panels, and figures share the frame, though a red pickup distracts.
notes.F: The barrel row dominates the back wall, and only the sarcophagus lid is visible.
notes.G: A close cobweb obscures the sarcophagus and barrels, while the nearest panel is cropped.
notes.H: Both figures and three burial panels are visible, but the sarcophagus is mostly cropped.

crypt.best: E shows the sarcophagus, burial panels, cobwebs, and both figures together, with enough floor visible to read the room.
crypt.lacks: The crypt lacks an architectural focus. Repeated burial panels and a row of barrels compete with the sarcophagus, which sits directly on the floor.
crypt.fix: Set the sarcophagus on a stepped stone dais so it reads as the room’s centerpiece.

blind_name.name: Crypt with a stone sarcophagus
blind_name.why: A stone sarcophagus sits among gold skeleton reliefs, cobwebs, and a wall torch.
blind_name.odd: The lid’s carved pattern is hard to make out.

notes.A: A lantern lights the path, but the near wall hides most of the yard.
notes.B: The high angle reveals the path around the church, but blank masonry dominates.
notes.C: The headstone gives the yard its identity, though a foreground shrub steals attention.
notes.D: The path and trees show the enclosure clearly, but the view misses the headstone.
notes.E: The church corner and leafless tree set the mood, but foreground foliage hides the yard.
notes.F: A bare tree stands against the church wall, while close branches crowd the frame.
notes.G: Two trees frame the path and city skyline, but the path ends without a focal point.
notes.H: Low walls lead the eye to an evergreen, while close branches obscure the church.

churchyard.best: C shows the lone headstone, autumn trees, and church wall together beneath the red city sky.
churchyard.lacks: One easily missed headstone carries the whole idea of a burial ground. The path has no memorable destination.
churchyard.fix: Place a small group of weathered headstones at the end of the path, anchored by one taller memorial.

blind_name.name: Walled churchyard
blind_name.why: High stone walls, bare trees, and scrub frame a dim courtyard beneath a red sky.
blind_name.odd: The foreground shrub is heavily pixelated and blends into the ground.

notes.A: The high angle shows the long brick frontage but makes the sign and entrance incidental.
notes.B: The bloodied departures board and torchlit hall show character, but the tight crop loses the approach.
notes.C: The sign, clock, and entrance are visible, but the near wall dominates the frame.
notes.D: The bloodied timetable and torch are clear, but the flat crop gives little spatial context.
notes.E: The corner reveals the side passage, but the receding angle makes the station lettering hard to read.
notes.F: The sign, clock, and doorway share the frame, though the doorway blends into the brickwork.
notes.G: The corner, sign, and red sky establish the setting, but the long wall overshadows the entrance.
notes.H: The sign reads clearly head-on, but the crop cuts off most of the entrance passage.

station_front.best: The station sign, clock, and recessed entrance sit together, with enough of the street to show how you approach.
station_front.lacks: The station has a sign, a clock, and a timetable, but it lacks a recognizable main entrance that anchors the long, repetitive frontage.
station_front.fix: Rebuild the recessed doorway as a tall, lit station portal that gives the street a clear destination.

blind_name.name: Brick building entrance
blind_name.why: A recessed entrance sits between rows of windows, with wall lamps and a cobblestone courtyard in front.
blind_name.odd: The round sign beside the entrance is too pixelated to read.

notes.A: Engine, coach, and rails read clearly. The train hides most of the platform.
notes.B: Curtains and green stripe identify the coach. Tight framing loses the platform.
notes.C: A brick corner frames a sliver of platform and coach roof. Brick dominates.
notes.D: Gates frame the carriage door across the platform. The near wall crowds the view.
notes.E: Curtains, carpet, and a standing figure give the coach character. The station disappears.
notes.F: Clock, signage, and benches give the station character. The coach roof fills the foreground.
notes.G: Rails lead past the full train. The recessed station bays fade into shadow.
notes.H: Coach windows sit below barred station bays. The roof hides the boarding area.

platform.best: The long view ties the parallel rails, green-striped train, and gated station frontage into one recognizable place.
platform.lacks: The platform lacks a clear boarding focal point. Its recessed bays blend into the long brick wall, so the train carries nearly all the scene’s identity.
platform.fix: Turn one recessed bay beside a carriage door into a brightly lit boarding entrance with a large station name above it.

blind_name.name: Train station platform
blind_name.why: Two sets of tracks run past a green-striped passenger carriage, with a clock on the brick wall behind it.
blind_name.odd: Several carriage windows look boarded up.

notes.A: Benches, a waiting figure and the ticket window define the hall. The clock is clipped.
notes.B: Benches flank the passage and timetable. The station name is cropped.
notes.C: The full station name, clock and occupied bench stand out. The ticket window is absent.
notes.D: The timetable and passage read clearly. The cropped bench barely suggests a waiting area.
notes.E: The low angle emphasizes the brickwork and side passage. The benches and booth fall outside.
notes.F: The occupied bench and iron columns give depth. A foreground column hides the ticket window.
notes.G: The stone passage fills the frame. Only slivers of the hall remain.
notes.H: Benches, columns and the distant ticket window show the layout. The wall clips the name.

booking_hall.best: The station name, ticket window, worn benches and waiting figure make the hall instantly recognizable.
booking_hall.lacks: A focal point worthy of a booking hall. The little ticket window recedes into the brickwork, leaving the bare passage to dominate.
booking_hall.fix: Rebuild the ticket window as a broad, warmly lit booking counter that anchors the hall.

blind_name.name: Waiting hall
blind_name.why: Two wooden benches sit on a tiled floor beneath a wall clock and framed pictures.
blind_name.odd: A rough gray rectangle interrupts the brick wall, and the far wall is hard to make out.

notes.A: The docks and city blocks establish the harbor, but foreground pilings hide much of the barge.
notes.B: The broadside shows the barge and its cargo clearly, but crops most of the waterfront.
notes.C: The hull, crates, and flag read together, though the foreground cargo box crowds the deck.
notes.D: The flag and water frame the deck, but a huge cargo box dominates the view.
notes.E: The crates and horned flag stand out, but the close-up hides the hull and canal.
notes.F: Crates and mast fill the frame, leaving little sense of the harbor around them.
notes.G: The canal and quay are clear, but bare walls and a cargo box dominate.
notes.H: The docks and city enclose the barge, but pilings break up its outline.

harbour.best: C puts the barge’s hull, cargo, and horned flag in one view, with the canal and burning skyline behind.
harbour.lacks: The harbor lacks a distinctive feature that shows how it works. Crates suggest cargo handling, but the barge and quay feel disconnected.
harbour.fix: Add a dockside loading crane with a crate suspended over the barge, making the cargo transfer visible and giving the harbor a recognizable silhouette.

blind_name.name: Pirate ship at a dock
blind_name.why: A skull flag flies from a wooden mast above a deck with cargo crates and water alongside.
blind_name.odd: The flag’s skull is faint, and the fiery background is hard to make out.

notes.A: The clock anchors a narrow aisle, but a foreground crate hides much of the hall.
notes.B: A braced crate sits between fixtures and blocks the view down the aisle.
notes.C: The crate and counter crowd the frame, leaving only a sliver of shelving.
notes.D: The long counter leads toward wooden panels, but its blank side dominates the view.
notes.E: Stocked shelves and checkerboard flooring suggest a market, though the island’s end hides its length.
notes.F: The island, clock and brick alcove establish character, but the counter obscures the aisles.
notes.G: The doorway connects the hall to a darker passage that takes over the view.
notes.H: The island and surrounding aisles read clearly, though the bare countertop gives little away.

market_hall.best: H shows the central island, checkerboard aisles, stock shelves and wall clock together, so the market’s layout reads immediately.
market_hall.lacks: The central island lacks a recognizable market display. Its bare checkerboard top makes the hall’s biggest feature read like a low wall.
market_hall.fix: Turn the central island into a produce stall with shallow bins and visibly distinct piles of goods.

blind_name.name: Tiled room with central counter
blind_name.why: A large rectangular counter dominates the checkerboard floor, with wooden panels and brick walls behind it.
blind_name.odd: The recess on the right is too dark to make out clearly.

notes.A: The wide aisle and tobacco counter establish the arcade, but the tobacco sign is cropped.
notes.B: The view across the aisle connects two shops, but the foreground jar dominates.
notes.C: The bookseller and robed figure give the arcade character, though neighboring storefronts recede into shadow.
notes.D: The bookseller, shelves, and wall art read clearly, but the wider arcade disappears.
notes.E: Clocks, pottery, and the bookshop hint at variety, but thick piers hide much of it.
notes.F: Two figures frame the bookshop entrance, but the closed bays make the arcade feel sparse.
notes.G: The clock shop window shows candles and pottery, but the steep angle crops the sign.
notes.H: The tiled entrance frames a glimpse of the arcade, but brick walls dominate.

arcade.best: C shows a readable bookshop, neighboring stalls, and two figures beneath the arcade’s patterned ceiling.
arcade.lacks: The arcade lacks a landmark. Repeated brick bays and dim lighting make the storefronts blend together, so the hall has no memorable center.
arcade.fix: Mount a large, illuminated working clock above the clock shop entrance, visible from both ends of the arcade.

blind_name.name: Candlelit library
blind_name.why: Bookshelves line the back wall behind a candlelit table on a checkerboard floor.
blind_name.odd: The lighting is dim, and the book spines are unreadable.

notes.A: The ticket sign and poster identify the lobby, but the low ceiling dominates.
notes.B: The hooded figure and poster give it character, but the doors recede into darkness.
notes.C: The overhang frames the doors and figures, though the carpet overwhelms the foreground.
notes.D: The corridor and potted plant show depth, but the oversized sprite blocks the foreground.
notes.E: The entrance and extinguisher give context, but the broad carpet leaves them stranded.
notes.F: The ornate corner and floor trim show the finishes, but little suggests a theater.
notes.G: The support post defines the overhang, but it competes with the distant entrance.
notes.H: The entrance and staff door read clearly, but the dark wall dominates.

auditorium.best: C shows the ornate overhang, theater entrance, staff door, and lobby figures together, with room to read the layout.
auditorium.lacks: The lobby lacks a focal point that says cinema. Repeated wallpaper and carpet draw more attention than the ticket window or theater entrance.
auditorium.fix: Build a warmly lit box office into the existing ticket alcove so it anchors the lobby.

blind_name.name: Ornate hall with a stage
blind_name.why: A low step runs along the raised platform, framed by red patterned walls and carved trim.
blind_name.odd: The left doorway is nearly lost in shadow.

notes.A: Framed pictures and bar stools give it character, but cropped foreground props clutter the view.
notes.B: The sign ties the bar and tables together, though the dark right wall feels empty.
notes.C: A torch lights one corner, while an oversized foreground prop hides much of the room.
notes.D: The centered sign anchors a broad view, but the foreground bottle competes for attention.
notes.E: The chair and stools frame a drinking table, but the near wall crowds the view.
notes.F: Several tables and bar stools are visible, but a wide post cuts off the room.
notes.G: Bottles, a goblet, and chairs suggest a drinker’s viewpoint, with the bar mostly hidden.
notes.H: The raised angle clarifies the bar’s layout, but cuts off the sign and nearest seating.

saloon.best: It shows the WHISKEY sign, bar, stools, and drinking tables together, with enough depth to read the room.
saloon.lacks: The saloon lacks a focal point at eye level. The counter and tables blend into the same dark wood, leaving the sign to carry most of the identity.
saloon.fix: Add a warmly backlit wall of bottle shelves behind the main counter, making the bar the room’s focal point.

blind_name.name: Saloon interior
blind_name.why: Wooden tables, bottles, goblets, and tall-backed chairs fill a dim, wood-paneled room.
blind_name.odd: The bottle label is too pixelated to read.

notes.A: The barred loans window and heavy door set the mood, but the merchandise is cropped.
notes.B: The loans window, shirts, and pawn counter read clearly, but the street display is missing.
notes.C: The window ledge displays a few wares, but the street’s brick facade dominates.
notes.D: The skeleton and window wares give it character, but the sidewalk pulls attention away.
notes.E: The street window frames the loans booth, but the pawn counter is out of sight.
notes.F: The door and display ledge flank a broad stretch of empty checkerboard floor.
notes.G: The loans booth and display ledge explain the layout, but the door dominates.
notes.H: The storefront pulls the shop together, though its frame clips the overhead sign.

pawn.best: The storefront view ties the street display, barred loans window, hanging clothes, and pawn counter together.
pawn.lacks: A convincing stock of secondhand goods. A few shirts, pots, and candles leave the shop feeling barely furnished.
pawn.fix: Turn the street-facing ledge into a densely stocked display of used radios, clocks, tools, and jewelry.

blind_name.name: Pawn shop display window
blind_name.why: Hanging shirts, pottery, and goblets are displayed behind a large storefront window.
blind_name.odd: No shop sign or price tags are visible.

notes.A: Cylinder, sludge and grating establish the hall, though the foreground crops the pool.
notes.B: Grating leads toward orange controls, but the near wall crowds the view.
notes.C: Sludge lettering, grating and controls orient the viewer, though the low overhang hides the machinery.
notes.D: The FILTER sign and green vat identify the process, but the narrow aisle hides the hall.
notes.E: Grating runs past the cylinder base and cropped sign, beneath a slab that dominates.
notes.F: A striped support and switch frame the raised grating, while bulky columns hide the equipment.
notes.G: Steel supports fill the frame, leaving only slivers of grating and an orange panel.
notes.H: The SLUDGE sign is clearest here, but the vat and cylinder are out of view.

machine_hall.best: A puts the central cylinder, green sludge, grated walkway and hazard stripes together in one readable view.
machine_hall.lacks: A focal machine that makes the filtration process legible. The vat, cylinder and controls look like separate fixtures.
machine_hall.fix: Build an exposed filter assembly over the vat, with a visible pipe feeding sludge from the central cylinder.

blind_name.name: Industrial machinery room
blind_name.why: A large metal cylinder stands beside a grated walkway, hazard stripes, and green liquid.
blind_name.odd: Dark lighting obscures some wall details.

notes.A: A bright masonry block fills the dead end and hides most of the passage.
notes.B: A torch marks a low side bay, with the sewer channel barely visible.
notes.C: A ceiling fan, rat, and sludge channel establish the sewer, but the far end disappears.
notes.D: Moss and a distant torch frame the channel, but repeating wall panels dominate.
notes.E: The walkway opens into a side bay, but bare flooring takes up most of it.
notes.F: Moss, debris, and the fan give the channel character, but the passage ends in shadow.
notes.G: A rat crosses the flooded bend, but a distant masonry block draws the eye.
notes.H: Floodwater wraps around a central wall, whose blank faces dominate the view.

sewer.best: F puts sludge, moss, debris, and a ceiling fan in one view down the cramped maintenance passage.
sewer.lacks: A recognizable landmark that explains the sewer’s function and distinguishes its junctions from the repeated low corridors.
sewer.fix: Install a lit sluice gate across the main junction so the channel leads to a visible piece of sewer machinery.

blind_name.name: Sewer corridor
blind_name.why: Rusted metal walls flank a narrow channel of green sludge beneath dim ceiling lights.
blind_name.odd: The orange-brown pile on the floor is hard to identify.

notes.A: The stone corridor leads to a dark opening that conceals the stairs.
notes.B: Stairs and corridor flank a foreground pier that hides where they meet.
notes.C: The exit sign and gate read clearly. The stairs are cropped to a sliver.
notes.D: The tiled landing opens onto both routes. Shadow swallows most of the upper stairwell.
notes.E: Patterned steps lead toward a glimpse of the upper room. The pier hides the gate.
notes.F: The exit sign frames the stairwell entrance. The turn hides most of the steps.
notes.G: The tiled landing turns toward rising steps. The low ceiling cuts off the upper landing.
notes.H: The pier fills the frame, leaving only a sliver of the barred corridor.

underpass.place: Underpass stairwell beside a barred corridor
underpass.best: D shows how the patterned landing connects the stairs and the exit-marked corridor, with the gate visible at its end.
underpass.lacks: The junction lacks a landmark. A blank pier dominates the meeting point, and the repeating masonry gives the two routes much the same character.
underpass.fix: Replace the blank face of the pier with a recessed, warmly lit guard booth overlooking the stair landing and barred corridor.

blind_name.name: Stone underpass with stairs
blind_name.why: A low stone ceiling spans a tiled passage with stairs on the left and a barred gate on the right.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure some wall and stair details.

notes.A: The checkered shop interior and rats stand out, but the frame clips the sign.
notes.B: The sign, rat counter, and door read clearly, but the tight frame loses the courtyard.
notes.C: The high angle shows rows of windows and cuts off the storefront at ground level.
notes.D: The wide view explains the ramp and barred gate, but the shop recedes sideways.
notes.E: The lamp, ramp, and hooded figure define the yard, though the lamp upstages the shop.
notes.F: Two figures and a lamp give the alley depth. The gray corner crowds the storefront.
notes.G: The shop, rats, and hooded figure share the frame, but the yard ends abruptly.
notes.H: Rats line the counter, but the close wall blocks most of the courtyard.

works_yard.best: E puts the shop, lamppost, hooded figure, and ramp in one frame, showing how the courtyard fits together.
works_yard.lacks: The yard lacks a focal point at ground level. The rat counter is tucked into a facade dominated by repeated windows.
works_yard.fix: Extend the Rat Dogs counter into the courtyard beneath the sign as a torchlit stall, with the rats visible from across the yard.

blind_name.name: Lamplit courtyard
blind_name.why: A glowing lamppost stands on dark paving, surrounded by brown walls with rows of arched windows.
blind_name.odd: The passage at the back is too dark to see where it leads.

notes.A: A figure in the brick opening adds menace. The cropped grill loses its shape.
notes.B: Stools lead toward the grill and wash-hands sign. The oversized foreground seat steals attention.
notes.C: Stools frame the rat-covered grill and kitchen wall. The grill still reads as a crate.
notes.D: Steel door, extinguisher, and stools dominate. The rat-covered grill barely makes the frame.
notes.E: Rats, pans, and the wash-hands sign establish the kitchen. One stool suggests little seating.
notes.F: The grill and kitchen fittings face us squarely. The near wall blocks the room’s depth.
notes.G: Rats line the brick opening beside the wooden door. The grill is cut off.
notes.H: Stools and grill show the layout clearly. Bare walls leave the diner theme underplayed.

ratdogs.best: C fits the stools, rat-covered grill, brick opening, and kitchen fixtures into one view that makes the room legible.
ratdogs.lacks: The room lacks a recognizable place to order or serve food. The low grill reads as a box, leaving the stools without a clear purpose.
ratdogs.fix: Rebuild the low grill as a waist-high lunch counter with a serving ledge facing the stools and rats clustered on the griddle.

blind_name.name: Kitchen with a central grill
blind_name.why: Two pans hang above a checkered floor, and three stools surround a raised metal grate.
blind_name.odd: The small brown shapes on the grate are hard to identify.
